commits.author: Daniel Okafor
commits.message:
perf(fx): remove live shadowBlur from the enemy layer

shadowBlur blurs every drawImage call on the layer. On Mali-G52 and
Adreno 610 this cost 15-20 ms per frame and caused constant hitches.
Shadows will come back pre-rendered in the sprite sheet.
